title: Class 2 'tic-tac' objects, about 40 feet long, seen in 2022, 2023 and February 2025
summary: James Valor tells of Class 2 'tic-tac' objects, about 40 feet long, seen in 2022, 2023 and February 2025, about 2022, 2023, 2025 at Skywatcher operations (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: James Valor, from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call UFOs into view, told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 about what his team calls Class 2 objects, or "tic tacs," white oval shapes like the mint. He says they are about 40 feet long and that his team saw them in 2022, in 2023 and again in February 2025. If true, it would mean a craft shape reported by others has been seen repeatedly by a private team.
